subject.title: feat(dashboard): split OpenClaw Bay publishing lane

question: Should OpenClaw Bay expose publication waiting and deterministic post-publication follow-up as separate first-class operational lanes?
rationale: This is a user-visible operational taxonomy choice rather than a mechanically required bug fix; code review alone cannot establish the preferred dashboard model.

options.title: Adopt the split
options.body: Keep Publishing and Applying distinct so the bounded publication backlog is not presented as active deterministic follow-up work.

options.title: Retain one lane
options.body: Keep the existing Applying lane if a simpler dashboard vocabulary is preferred over more precise workflow-state visibility.

recommendation.title: Adopt the split
recommendation.body: Keep Publishing and Applying distinct so the bounded publication backlog is not presented as active deterministic follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy identifies Peter as the likely owner for ClawSweeper operational-direction decisions.
